Delta reported Q2 revenue of USD 47 million. Epsilon reported Q2 revenue of USD 19 million.

デルタの売上高は前年同期比で7%増加した。

Delta did not reduce its monthly capacity to 6,200 wafers.

An unconfirmed report says Delta may have increased revenue by USD 2 million; the company has not verified the report.
